newsitem.title: INDIA: India IPCL sees H1 96/97 net at 2.2 bln.
newsitem.headline: India IPCL sees H1 96/97 net at 2.2 bln.

text.p: The state-run Indian Petrochemical Corporation Ltd (IPCL) expects a sales turnover of 13.5 billion rupees and a net profit of 2.2 billion rupees for the first half of 1996/97 (April-March), chairman K.G. Ramanathan told shareholders at its annual general meeting.

"During the current year, our complexes at Vadodara and Nagothane continue to operate well and production volumes are expected about four percent higher than that of the corresponding period of last year," he told the meeting held in the western city of Vadodara.
"There are signs of stabilisation of international prices of our products which coupled with additional volumes should help our company in the second half of the current year," he said.
